_comment: Lives at .opensdd/mr-config.json (created by /f-start) and edited per project. Used by /f-mr to assign reviewers and decide merge strategy. This file is local to each developer — /f-start gitignores .opensdd/, so it is NOT committed. Each developer sets their own reviewers/target_branch.

_field_docs.reviewers: GitLab usernames (NOT display names or email addresses). Validated against the GitLab API when glab is available; passed through unverified in manual mode. The MR author is auto-excluded.
_field_docs.target_branch: Branch the MR will target. Defaults to 'development' if absent.
_field_docs.merge_strategy: 'squash' (default) — collapses all branch commits into one; 'merge' — preserves full commit history; 'rebase' — rebases onto target. Squash is performed locally before push so the MR shows a single commit even when glab isn't used.
